jutsu.name: Wind Cutter
jutsu.description: A precise gust that punishes exposed movement.

jutsu.name: Stone Guard
jutsu.description: Raises cover and slows an advance.

jutsu.name: Binding Wire
jutsu.description: Places a quiet restraint before the fight is decided.

jutsu.name: Scout's Eye
jutsu.description: Reads tracks and contradictions in a scene.

jutsu.name: Mist Step
jutsu.description: Breaks line of sight and changes the angle of pursuit.

jutsu.name: Warding Palm
jutsu.description: Stabilizes an ally or secures a vulnerable objective.

jutsu.name: Sealing Mark
jutsu.description: Turns preparation into a boundary the enemy must respect.

jutsu.name: Gale Lance
jutsu.description: A committed high-speed strike for decisive openings.

jutsu.name: Ember Thread
jutsu.description: Heated filament divides routes and punishes an overextension.

jutsu.name: Mirror Shroud
jutsu.description: A refracting veil makes a direct assault choose the wrong target.

jutsu.name: Pulse Heal
jutsu.description: Reads disrupted chakra and stabilizes an ally under pressure.

jutsu.name: Resonance Field
jutsu.description: A vibrating field reveals movement and disrupts hidden approaches.

jutsu.name: Barrier Lattice
jutsu.description: A layered ward protects a route or a person rather than merely absorbing damage.

jutsu.name: Void Step
jutsu.description: Leaves a delayed afterimage and repositions through a blind angle.

jutsu.name: Iron Root
jutsu.description: Anchors the battlefield and denies a fleeing enemy their preferred ground.

jutsu.name: Silken Snare
jutsu.description: Extends a hidden restraint into a living net that makes pursuit itself dangerous.

jutsu.name: Sentinel Lattice
jutsu.description: Joins cover and observation into a ward that warns allies before impact.

jutsu.name: Gale Passage
jutsu.description: Turns a moving wind cut into a route only its user can exploit.

jutsu.name: Cinder Seal
jutsu.description: A heated seal brands a route, punishing both escape and reinforcement.

jutsu.name: Echo Map
jutsu.description: Turns remembered traces into a moving map that reveals the safest route.

jutsu.name: Blindside Mark
jutsu.description: Marks a blind angle so a pursuer meets a trap instead of a target.

jutsu.name: Emergency Thread
jutsu.description: Stitches a disrupted chakra flow long enough to keep an ally in the mission.

jutsu.name: Reflex Bloom
jutsu.description: A restorative pulse becomes a brief moving shelter during an extraction.

jutsu.name: Seal Relay
jutsu.description: Links two prepared marks so an ally can redirect the fight through a chosen route.

jutsu.name: Null Boundary
jutsu.description: A high-grade seal erases a narrow route from the enemy's tactical map.

jutsu.name: Rush Break
jutsu.description: Turns a reckless advance into a guarded collision that breaks the opponent's tempo.

jutsu.name: Anchor Crash
jutsu.description: Pins the battlefield in place before delivering a decisive close-range impact.

jutsu.name: Nocturne Thread
jutsu.description: Draws a silent line through cover, turning pursuit into a disappearing act.

jutsu.name: Command Mesh
jutsu.description: Shares a short tactical read through linked signals, letting a team react as one.

jutsu.name: Hammerfall
jutsu.description: Uses a defensive anchor as the beginning of a weapon-like counterattack.

jutsu.name: Dream Anchor
jutsu.description: Leaves a believable false certainty in the enemy's senses, then punishes the commitment.

jutsu.name: Paper Sparrow
jutsu.description: A folded scout follows air currents and returns with the shape of a guarded route.

jutsu.name: Silence Knot
jutsu.description: Ties sound to a chosen doorway, making one noisy mistake dangerously obvious.

jutsu.name: Lantern Echo
jutsu.description: Stores a chakra signature in a lantern flame so allies can find each other through fog.

jutsu.name: River Skin
jutsu.description: Spreads a thin moving layer of water over the body to slip holds and soften falls.

jutsu.name: Borrowed Shadow
jutsu.description: Anchors an ally's silhouette to yours, letting one of you vanish while the other holds attention.

jutsu.name: Reverse Sigil
jutsu.description: Turns an enemy's marked route into a warning line instead of a trap.

jutsu.name: Gravity Thread
jutsu.description: A tension line redirects a leap, fall or charge without pretending to stop momentum.

jutsu.name: Pollen Memory
jutsu.description: Dust remembers the last disturbance, revealing where a room changed before you arrived.

jutsu.name: Hollow Drum
jutsu.description: A delayed vibration forces opponents to choose between balance, cover and silence.

jutsu.name: Ink Well
jutsu.description: Spills chakra ink into footprints and seals only the path an enemy chooses to take.

jutsu.name: Bone Chime
jutsu.description: A tuning charm catches the tiny shifts that precede a concealed strike.

jutsu.name: Sand Clock
jutsu.description: Marks a brief window in which a retreat, treatment or seal must be completed.

jutsu.name: Knot of Return
jutsu.description: A paired anchor lets an ally reverse one committed route, turning a failed advance into an extraction.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Wood Sprout
jutsu.description: Living roots claim loose ground and create a first piece of cover.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Grove Cage
jutsu.description: Branches grow around an escape route, forcing surrender, a cut path or collateral damage.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Living Bastion
jutsu.description: A wall grows around a person or objective and can be reshaped by allies inside it.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Pollen Hush
jutsu.description: A quiet pollen cloud makes pursuit uncertain without serving as an instant knockout.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Root Siphon
jutsu.description: Roots bind a hostile chakra flow long enough to stabilize a seal or rescue.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Canopy Bridge
jutsu.description: Grows a temporary route over broken terrain, turning evacuation into a tactical option.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Forest Archive
jutsu.description: Living bark records tremors, tracks and impacts across the ground you have claimed.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Thorn Orbit
jutsu.description: A rotating crown of branches punishes direct pressure while protecting a vulnerable center.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Elder Grove
jutsu.description: Establishes a living zone whose routes, cover and escape options belong to its keeper.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Frost Breath
jutsu.description: A dry cold marks air currents and makes hidden movement visible in breath and rime.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Mirror Floe
jutsu.description: Creates a skating reflection that changes the angle of entry without granting teleportation.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Rime Cage
jutsu.description: Freezes a narrow corridor into a prison that can also keep a threat away from civilians.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Whiteout Path
jutsu.description: Builds a drifting white corridor that hides an extraction but confuses the whole field.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Ice Suture
jutsu.description: Cools and braces an injury long enough to move an ally, never replacing recovery.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Frozen Sensor
jutsu.description: A thin frost field turns vibrations into a readable map of pressure and direction.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Zero Bridge
jutsu.description: Freezes a crossing under exact footfalls, then melts it before pursuit can use it.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Glass Hail
jutsu.description: Suspended ice shards deny open ground and force the enemy into your chosen cover.

jutsu.name: Hyoton: Winter Prison
jutsu.description: A reflective cold chamber confines a target while showing every attempt to break out.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Prism Shard
jutsu.description: Grows a precise crystal edge that pins equipment, terrain or an opening rather than merely cutting.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Crystal Bulwark
jutsu.description: Raises a faceted barrier whose angles deliberately redirect rather than absorb every attack.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Resonance Prism
jutsu.description: A crystal hum translates nearby chakra pulses into a shared warning signal.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Gem Snare
jutsu.description: Leaves nearly invisible facets that lock only when a target commits weight to a route.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Facet Step
jutsu.description: Uses a briefly grown facet as a rebound point to change a dash into a guarded angle.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Geode Shelter
jutsu.description: Encloses an injured ally in a ventilated crystalline shelter that buys time but limits sight.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Refract Field
jutsu.description: Breaks sight-lines into misleading layers and lets careful allies read the true reflection.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Crystal Choir
jutsu.description: A ring of tuned crystals disrupts coordination and opens a precise collective counter.

jutsu.name: Shoton: Cathedral Spire
jutsu.description: Rebuilds a section of battlefield into towering cover, choke points and dangerous reflections.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Ink Echo
jutsu.description: Gives a false trace just enough substance to draw attention away from a real route.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Null Palm
jutsu.description: Interrupts one hostile chakra pattern at contact range without erasing the opponent's agency.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Form Stitch
jutsu.description: Temporarily reconnects a damaged tool, barrier or chakra route so a mission can continue.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Yin Lantern
jutsu.description: Illuminates intent rather than bodies, exposing hesitation, decoys and concealed fear.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Yang Knot
jutsu.description: Binds living force around an ally long enough to resist collapse and complete an extraction.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Shadow Pulse
jutsu.description: Lets a projected shadow carry a single disruptive pulse through an overlooked angle.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Soul Cordon
jutsu.description: Creates a consent-bound tether that keeps allies from becoming lost in a changing battlefield.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Balance Rite
jutsu.description: Balances two opposing chakra pressures at a cost, preventing either side from escalating freely.

jutsu.name: Yin-Yang: Origin Weave
jutsu.description: A high-risk rite redraws a broken tactical relationship: seal, route, body and intent must all be read correctly.

jutsu.name: Sand Style: Grain Sense
jutsu.description: Loose grains remember pressure, making repeated footsteps and false routes readable.

jutsu.name: Sand Style: Moving Bulwark
jutsu.description: A mobile shield protects an ally or objective but can be drawn away by divided threats.

jutsu.name: Sand Style: Sepulcher Route
jutsu.description: Buried grains close only the route a target repeats, rewarding prediction over raw force.

jutsu.name: Magnet Release: Lodestone Mark
jutsu.description: Marks metal, tools and prepared weapons so their route can be read or redirected.

jutsu.name: Magnet Release: Iron Orbit
jutsu.description: A disciplined orbit deflects one line while threatening another; it cannot cover every angle.

jutsu.name: Magnet Release: Polarity Prison
jutsu.description: Opposed marks turn weapons and armor into a reluctant restraint around a committed target.

jutsu.name: Lava Release: Magma Seam
jutsu.description: Draws a hot fault across a route, forcing a detour and leaving a dangerous aftermath.

jutsu.name: Lava Release: Basalt Rampart
jutsu.description: Cools lava into harsh cover that protects one side while permanently reshaping access.

jutsu.name: Lava Release: Caldera Net
jutsu.description: A web of heat zones creates an evacuation corridor for allies and a costly maze for everyone else.

jutsu.name: Boil Release: Steam Veil
jutsu.description: A controlled veil erases clean sight-lines but risks separating careless allies.

jutsu.name: Boil Release: Caustic Ring
jutsu.description: Corrosive mist protects a narrow perimeter and makes reckless entry an informed cost.

jutsu.name: Boil Release: Pressure Kettle
jutsu.description: Compresses steam behind cover, then vents it to break a formation without deleting the battlefield.

jutsu.name: Scorch Release: Heat Haze
jutsu.description: Bends sight through heat, concealing a movement at the cost of draining nearby water and cover.

jutsu.name: Scorch Release: Sun Needle
jutsu.description: A narrow beam punishes exposed chakra flow, rewarding a read rather than indiscriminate destruction.

jutsu.name: Scorch Release: Drought Circle
jutsu.description: Creates a punishing dry zone that denies recovery, cover and patience to both sides.

jutsu.name: Storm Release: Storm Thread
jutsu.description: A fine electric mist traces motion through rain, smoke and broken sight-lines.

jutsu.name: Storm Release: Arc Relay
jutsu.description: Passes a precise current between marked allies to coordinate a counter from separated positions.

jutsu.name: Storm Release: Thunder Grid
jutsu.description: A network of arcs makes sudden movement readable and forces a target to choose a safer route.

jutsu.name: Explosion Release: Blast Seed
jutsu.description: Plants a directional charge that opens rubble or cover without reducing every answer to an explosion.

jutsu.name: Explosion Release: Breach Step
jutsu.description: Uses a controlled blast to cross a defended angle, accepting noise and exposure for initiative.

jutsu.name: Explosion Release: Demolition Cordon
jutsu.description: Demolishes a chosen route while preserving an escape corridor for civilians and allies.

jutsu.name: Metal Release: Iron Filament
jutsu.description: Draws flexible metal lines between cover, turning equipment into a defendable boundary.

jutsu.name: Metal Release: Forged Step
jutsu.description: Forges a temporary foothold or shield edge exactly where a route would otherwise fail.

jutsu.name: Metal Release: Armory Bastion
jutsu.description: Reconfigures nearby equipment into a moving shelter, strong only while logistics remain intact.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Ember Route
jutsu.description: Places controlled flame along an avenue to split a formation and expose its chosen exit.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Smoke Covenant
jutsu.description: Signals allies through smoke while concealing a withdrawal from observers.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Firebreak Command
jutsu.description: Burns one route clean to prevent a larger spread, deciding what the field is allowed to consume.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Tide Thread
jutsu.description: Runs water through cracks to pull a tool, message or ally's hand toward safety.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Current Shelter
jutsu.description: A rolling current softens impact and escorts an ally through a threatened corridor.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Undertow Court
jutsu.description: Creates a shifting pool that reveals pressure, drags overcommitted feet and keeps a retreat open.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Air Script
jutsu.description: Writes a momentary pattern in dust and leaves to read airflow, hidden doors and movement.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Shear Line
jutsu.description: Cuts a route cleanly enough to deny a weapon swing without pretending to erase armor.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Crosswind Lift
jutsu.description: Lifts an ally over danger or redirects a charge into an angle the team prepared.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Clay Mark
jutsu.description: Softens one patch of ground so pressure, tunnels and footsteps leave a readable record.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Fault Door
jutsu.description: Raises a short earthen door that shields one angle while opening another planned exit.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Terrace Fort
jutsu.description: Builds layered cover and elevation, making defense a sequence of positions rather than a wall.

jutsu.name: Lightning Style: Spark Sense
jutsu.description: A low current reads conductive routes, wet ground and the instant before a weapon is drawn.

jutsu.name: Lightning Style: Flash Lure
jutsu.description: A controlled flash steals one reaction and makes an enemy reveal which threat they feared most.

jutsu.name: Lightning Style: Thunder Clasp
jutsu.description: A close-range current locks a commitment in place just long enough for a capture or escape.

jutsu.name: Kurogane Eye: Thread Vision
jutsu.description: Reads the commitment behind a movement and marks the route it is most likely to take.

jutsu.name: Lumen Eye: Pulse Lattice
jutsu.description: Makes disrupted chakra visible long enough to stabilize an ally or expose a false recovery.

jutsu.name: Ashen Eye: Fracture Mark
jutsu.description: Finds the single line where a defense must choose between breaking or yielding ground.

jutsu.name: Sharingan: Counter Memory
jutsu.description: Stores the rhythm of one hostile technique and turns its repeated opening into a counter-route.

jutsu.name: Byakugan: Chakra Compass
jutsu.description: Maps tenketsu, hidden sentries and safe passages without pretending every target is defenseless.

jutsu.name: Rinnegan: Vector Exchange
jutsu.description: Redirects a single committed force across the field, demanding careful timing instead of raw erasure.

jutsu.name: Tenseigan: Orbit Ward
jutsu.description: Sets a pale orbit around an ally or objective, creating a moving defensive angle.

jutsu.name: Ketsuryugan: Ironblood Verdict
jutsu.description: Turns a witnessed injury or blood trace into a coercive illusion with a real ethical cost.

jutsu.name: Jogan: Fault Aperture
jutsu.description: Sees a stressed seam between barriers, routes and dimensions, revealing one improbable exit.

jutsu.name: Kagura Eye: Echo of Intent
jutsu.description: Hears the emotional pressure behind a chakra signature, separating fear, coercion and deliberate betrayal.

specializations.name: Tracker
specializations.description: Changes mission intelligence and pursuit options; it is not a damage bonus.

specializations.name: Field Medic
specializations.description: Turns support and recovery into field control, including stronger stabilization.

specializations.name: Sealwright
specializations.description: Uses preparation and boundaries to turn routes, objects and objectives into tactical tools.

specializations.name: Vanguard
specializations.description: Creates openings through decisive pressure and movement, accepting exposure for tempo.

specializations.name: Shadow Runner
specializations.description: Makes stealth and repositioning into a field-control discipline rather than a damage style.

specializations.name: Tactician
specializations.description: Turns tactical reading into routes, calls and coordinated control.

specializations.name: Ironhand
specializations.description: Builds close-range pressure from guarded positions and durable counters.

specializations.name: Mirage Weaver
specializations.description: Uses misdirection and perception to make the opponent commit to the wrong reality.

bloodlines.name: Kurogane Eye
bloodlines.hook: Reads motion patterns; evolves through insight and strain.

bloodlines.name: Lumen Eye
bloodlines.hook: Reads disrupted chakra flow; favors support and counter-technique timing.

bloodlines.name: Ashen Eye
bloodlines.hook: Finds fracture points in defenses; favors pressure but amplifies strain.

bloodlines.name: Mokuton
bloodlines.hook: Claims terrain with living structures; its techniques make containment, guarding and rescues materially different.

bloodlines.name: Hyoton
bloodlines.hook: Controls routes, reflections and temperature; excels at interception, extraction and constrained movement.

bloodlines.name: Shoton
bloodlines.hook: Builds refracting structures whose angles reshape cover, sight-lines and enemy commitments.

bloodlines.name: Yin–Yang Release
bloodlines.hook: Rare form-and-intent discipline: stabilizes, interrupts and redefines tactical relationships at a high chakra cost.

bloodlines.name: Sand Style
bloodlines.hook: Persistent grains reveal movement, reinforce chosen routes and punish repeated commitments.

bloodlines.name: Magnet Release
bloodlines.hook: Turns marks, metal and equipment into a directional control system.

bloodlines.name: Lava Release
bloodlines.hook: Trades long-term terrain safety for irreversible short-term denial.

bloodlines.name: Boil Release
bloodlines.hook: Uses steam and corrosion to make approach and visibility expensive.

bloodlines.name: Scorch Release
bloodlines.hook: Dries space and resources into a high-pressure, high-collateral field.

bloodlines.name: Storm Release
bloodlines.hook: Connects motion, targeting and signals through a fast electric field.

bloodlines.name: Explosion Release
bloodlines.hook: Breaks structures and formations while preserving only the escape you planned.

bloodlines.name: Metal Release
bloodlines.hook: Converts equipment and cover into durable, movable logistics.

bloodlines.name: Fire Style
bloodlines.hook: Pressures routes through controlled spread and deliberate firebreaks.

bloodlines.name: Water Style
bloodlines.hook: Moves bodies, objects and safe routes rather than only producing attacks.

bloodlines.name: Wind Style
bloodlines.hook: Makes angles, air and momentum into offensive mobility.

bloodlines.name: Earth Style
bloodlines.hook: Claims elevation, cover and retreat paths as positional choices.

bloodlines.name: Lightning Style
bloodlines.hook: Turns reaction windows and conductive routes into tempo advantages.

dojutsu.name: Kurogane Eye
dojutsu.hook: Reads motion patterns and closes intent-driven routes.

dojutsu.name: Lumen Eye
dojutsu.hook: Reads disrupted chakra and creates support counterplay.

dojutsu.name: Ashen Eye
dojutsu.hook: Finds fracture points in defenses at escalating strain.

dojutsu.name: Sharingan
dojutsu.hook: Learns repeated combat rhythms and punishes predictable technique chains.

dojutsu.name: Byakugan
dojutsu.hook: Maps chakra pathways, sentries and restricted routes.

dojutsu.name: Rinnegan
dojutsu.hook: Reframes force and positioning, with heavy chakra commitments.

dojutsu.name: Tenseigan
dojutsu.hook: Builds orbital protection and aerial angles around chosen objectives.

dojutsu.name: Ketsuryugan
dojutsu.hook: Uses blood traces and coercive illusion to expose hidden intent.

dojutsu.name: Jogan
dojutsu.hook: Reads fault-lines in barriers and impossible movement routes.

dojutsu.name: Kagura Eye
dojutsu.hook: Interprets emotional pressure in chakra signatures to separate fear from agency.

summons.name: Toad Contract
summons.terms: Pragmatic scouts who value fulfilled favors over obedience.

summons.name: Corvid Contract
summons.terms: Information brokers who trade reconnaissance for secrets and favors.

summons.name: Hound Contract
summons.terms: Relentless trackers who demand directness and a clear hunt.

summons.name: Moth Contract
summons.terms: Night moths that trade light, pollen and secrets for patient stewardship.

summons.name: Boar Contract
summons.terms: Stubborn earthbreakers who respect direct commitments and defended ground.

bijuu.name: Shukaku, o Ichibi
bijuu.temperament: territorial, sarcástico e obcecado por selos e areia

bijuu.name: Matatabi, a Nibi
bijuu.temperament: orgulhosa, veloz e avessa a ser usada como arma

bijuu.name: Isobu, o Sanbi
bijuu.temperament: silencioso, defensivo e paciente como maré

bijuu.name: Son Gokū, o Yonbi
bijuu.temperament: direto, impaciente e ferozmente contrário à dominação

bijuu.name: Kokuō, o Gobi
bijuu.temperament: digno, veloz e atento a promessas cumpridas

bijuu.name: Saiken, o Rokubi
bijuu.temperament: gentil, cauteloso e protetor de quem não tem poder

bijuu.name: Chōmei, o Nanabi
bijuu.temperament: curiosa, luminosa e inquieta diante de segredo

bijuu.name: Gyūki, o Hachibi
bijuu.temperament: pragmático, paciente e exigente com disciplina

bijuu.name: Kurama, a Kyūbi
bijuu.temperament: orgulhoso, calculista e intolerante a jaulas

bijuu.name: Jūbi, a Dez-Caudas
bijuu.temperament: uma consciência primordial que não oferece parceria, apenas um pacto de contenção
